Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly recorded George Sherman’s death year as 2011 instead of 1991, despite sources in step 6 indicating 1991. This misentry led to the wrong comparison (2011 vs 2010) and the incorrect conclusion that Vasantha Sena’s director died first; in fact, George Sherman (The Crime Doctor’s Courage) died earlier (1991) than B. S. Ranga (2010).
